architecture: v0.5.7 structure matching plus v0.5.8 historical post-current continuation. Actual current data ends at the verified current date; only selected historical analogs continue for 126 trading days to the right.

cycle.title: 실제 사이클 비교 · 현재 이후 과거 6개월 포함
cycle.current_path_rule: Actual current series stops exactly at current_context.current_date and is never extended with synthetic future values.
cycle.historical_after_rule: After the aligned current point, show the selected historical analog's actual next 126 trading days in a shaded region.
cycle.forecast_rule: Historical continuation is descriptive history, not a forecast or predicted future high/low date.
cycle.selection_rule: Candidate score uses prior rise/fall structure and current rebound shape only through the aligned current point.

hourly_automation_rule: Update market live/latest/archive JSON only; never rewrite UI, VERSION, cycle datasets, market-daily, compounder returns, or ai-gems.
apk_done_definition: Browser QA success -> Android Actions success -> artifact exists -> APK downloadable and verified -> provide APK directly to user
